## Exploration report: Pho Jupyter Cell Tags

**Bottom line for non-destructive filtering:** The extension has **no implemented notebook-cell hide/filter**. Closest pieces are **tree-view/outline filtering** (UI only), **decorations/highlights**, and a **planned** `remove-cell` flow that temporarily **deletes** cells from the open document (not non-destructive to the model). VS Code has no public cell-hide API; the plan file states that explicitly.

---

### 1. Project structure overview

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\` | TypeScript sources (feature modules) |
| `...\out\` | Compiled JS (`main`: `./out/extension.js`) |
| `...\package.json` | Manifest: commands, views, menus, engines |
| `...\examples\` | Test notebooks, decoration docs |
| `...\images\` | Marketplace/README images |
| `...\.kiro\` | Steering + custom-outline specs |
| `...\.cursor\plans\` | Feature plans (incl. cell hiding) |
| `...\README.md` | User-facing + pending features |

**Feature modules under `src/`** (activated from `extension.ts`):

- `cellTags/` — add/remove/display tags on cells  
- `noteAllTags/` — All Notebook Tags tree + scrollbar decorators  
- `notebookRunGroups/` — execute cells by tag  
- `customOutline/` — custom outline + **text filter of outline items**  
- `cellHeadings/`, `cellJumpbacks/`, `cellExecution/`, `cellHistory/`  
- `gitDiff/`, `dependencyChain/`, `jupyterEnhancements/`, `ringMeJupyter/`  
- `tagProperties/`, `exportTags/`, `importTags/`, `cellMetadataDisplay/`  
- `util/`, `helper.ts`, `models/`

**Not present:** `src/removeCell/` (planned only).

### 2. How cell tags are read / written / displayed

**Read** — `getCellTags()` in `src\helper.ts`:

- Path depends on `useCustomMetadata()` (`src\util\notebookMetadata.ts`):  
  - custom: `cell.metadata.custom.metadata.tags`  
  - else: `cell.metadata.metadata.tags`

**Write** — `updateCellTags()` in `src\helper.ts`:

- Clones metadata, sets/deletes `tags`, sorts via `sortObjectPropertiesRecursively`
- Applies `WorkspaceEdit` + `NotebookEdit.updateCellMetadata`
- Optional `defer_apply` returns the edit for batching

Related writers:

- `addCellTag` / `addTagsToMultipleCells` — `src\cellTags\cellTags.ts`
- Import — `src\importTags\importTags.ts` → `updateCellTags`
- Rename / remove-from-all — `AllTagsTreeDataProvider` commands in `src\noteAllTags\allNotebookTagsTreeDataProvider.ts`
- Tag properties (priority, color, `createdAt`) — notebook-level `metadata.tagProperties` via `TagPropertiesManager` (`src\tagProperties\tagPropertiesManager.ts`)

**Display:**

| Surface | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Cell status bar chips | `CellTagStatusBarProvider` — `registerNotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider('jupyter-notebook', …)` |
| All Notebook Tags tree | `AllTagsTreeDataProvider` + `TagTreeItem` / `CellTreeItem` |
| Scrollbar markers | `ScrollbarDecoratorManager` — `createTextEditorDecorationType` + `setDecorations` |
| Edit tags in JSON | Opens `.ipynb` text beside editor, selects `cells[i].metadata.tags` via `json.ts` |

**Note:** `contributes.views` declares `cell-tag` under `jupyter-variables`, but **no `createTreeView('cell-tag')` / provider is registered** in this repo. Menus still reference `view == cell-tag`; the working tags UI is `all-notebook-tags-view`.

| Planned `remove-cell` hiding | `.cursor\plans\remove-cell_cell_hiding_b1d649a4.plan.md` — temp `deleteCells` + save restore | Destructive to open model; **not implemented** |

**Not found:** notebook fold APIs, cell collapse APIs, or non-destructive cell visibility filtering.

### 7. `NotebookCellExecution`, `WorkspaceEdit` cell mods, fold/hide

**`NotebookCellExecution` (controller API):** not used. Naming is only `activateNotebookCellExecutionTracking`, which listens to `onDidChangeNotebookDocument` / execution summaries and hijacks execute commands—not the `NotebookCellExecution` class.

**`WorkspaceEdit` that changes cells/content:**

- Metadata: tags, run groups, notify-on-complete, notebook `tagProperties`  
- Structure: `deleteCells` (outline), `insertCells` (scratchpad)  
- Text: heading depth (`edit.replace` on cell document), scratchpad body  

**Fold / hide APIs:** none in source. Collapse is tree-UI only. Planned hide = temporary delete (destructive to open notebook model).

---

### Implications for non-destructive tag/criteria filtering

1. **Reuse for criteria:** `getCellTags()`, `AllTagsTreeDataProvider` tag→cells map, `TagPropertiesManager`.  
2. **Non-destructive patterns already in the codebase:** decorations, selection/reveal, tree filtering—not removing cells from the document.  
3. **Destructive patterns to avoid for “non-destructive”:** `NotebookEdit.deleteCells` / `insertCells` (outline delete, scratchpad, planned remove-cell).  
4. **Gap:** VS Code does not expose a true hide-cell API here; any real “hide in editor” likely needs proposed APIs, CSS/webview hacks, or temporary model edits with careful save handling (as in the pending plan)—none of which preserve an unchanged open notebook model today.
